name: The Missing Diplomat
summary: Dashel Stonefist has confessed in Old Town, and you carry his warning to Elling Trias. The thug names a backup abduction plot and a contact in Menethil Harbor.

sections.title: A Crack in the Wall
sections.body: Dashel Stonefist gives up when he fears for his health. In an Old Town alley, he admits the conspirators' first kidnapping plan fell apart, leaving his part in the plot in ruins. To shift blame, he tells you of a secret meeting weeks ago at Addle's Stead in Duskwood. He also names one lead in their backup plan: an insider in Menethil Harbor known only as Slim.

sections.title: Reporting to the Fromager
sections.body: Elling Trias gathers secrets for the Crown from behind the counter of Trias' Cheese in the Trade District. While you questioned Dashel, Trias studied captured messages about the plot. The confession matches what they reveal: the conspirators targeted an unnamed diplomat, their first ambush failed, and a backup plan began through the Wetlands. With Slim's name, the search turns north from Stormwind toward the marshes.

faq.answer: Dashel Stonefist is a fixer and strong arm in Stormwind's Old Town. Linked to the Defias underworld, he helped carry out the first plan to capture Stormwind's envoy, then gave information when confronted.

faq.q: Why is Elling Trias involved in this investigation?
faq.answer: Elling Trias gathers secrets for Stormwind while posing as a master of fine cheeses. His Trade District shop lets him coordinate discreet inquiries beyond the city guard's reach.
The conspirators met weeks ago at Addle's Stead, an abandoned farm in western Duskwood, to plan their kidnappings after their first attempt was disrupted.

faq.q: Who is the diplomat they were trying to abduct?
faq.answer: The conspirators' documents and street thugs identify their target only as an unnamed diplomat bound for Theramore. The envoy's identity remains closely guarded at this point in the investigation.

Slim is the name Dashel Stonefist gives for the contact handling the backup plan from Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. The contact represents the conspirators' second route for moving people and supplies.

faq.q: Where does the trail lead after this?
faq.answer: The trail leads north to Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands, where Slim is said to be. Elling Trias confirms Dashel's information.

angles.text: As a rogue, you know how closely street crime and state secrets can meet, from Dashel's back-alley muscle to Trias's quiet intelligence work.
As a human, you see a conspiracy unfolding within Stormwind's borders while the boy-king sits on the throne.
As an Alliance member, you know the missing envoy matters to the Alliance's stability, with sabotage threatening Stormwind's leadership.
